parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS request
), scoped AS (
  SELECT i.request, b.id, b.local_operator_id, b.title, b.target_words, b.chapter_words,
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.l1a_unit l WHERE l.book_id=b.id AND l.is_locked AND l.is_valid AND NOT l.is_shadow) AS design_editable
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN public.book_project b ON b.id=(i.request->>'book_id')::uuid AND b.local_operator_id=(i.request->>'local_operator_id')::uuid
), resolved AS (
  SELECT s.*, CASE WHEN s.request->>'action'='sort' THEN COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_build_object('node_code',binding.node_code,'model_name',binding.model_name,'provider_base_url',binding.provider_base_url,'api_key_ref',binding.api_key_ref,'temperature',binding.temperature,'prompt_text',binding.prompt_text,'prompt_status',binding.prompt_status,'model_config_version',binding.model_config_version,'prompt_version',binding.prompt_version)
    FROM public.v_prompt_runtime_binding binding
    WHERE binding.local_operator_id=s.local_operator_id AND binding.node_code='FP004-02' AND binding.prompt_status='active'
      AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.model_name),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.provider_base_url),'') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.api_key_ref),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(binding.prompt_text),'') IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY binding.model_config_version DESC,binding.prompt_version DESC LIMIT 1
  ),'{}'::jsonb) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END AS binding
  FROM scoped s
)
SELECT CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'correlation_id',r.request->>'correlation_id','redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','SCOPE_REJECTED','message','The selected book is unavailable.'))
ELSE jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'correlation_id',r.request->>'correlation_id','context',jsonb_build_object(
  'book',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'title',r.title,'target_words',r.target_words,'chapter_words',r.chapter_words),
  'design_editable',r.design_editable,'design_fingerprint',public.v7_formal_design_fingerprint(r.id),
  'candidate_fingerprint',encode(digest(convert_to(COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l)-'created_at'-'updated_at' ORDER BY l.id) FROM public.l1a_unit l WHERE l.book_id=r.id AND NOT l.is_formal AND l.is_valid AND NOT l.is_shadow AND NOT l.is_locked),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'sort_index_start',1,
  'runtime_binding',r.binding,
  'l1as',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l)-'created_at'-'updated_at' ORDER BY l.l1a_index,l.id) FROM public.l1a_unit l WHERE l.book_id=r.id AND NOT l.is_formal AND l.is_valid AND NOT l.is_shadow),'[]'::jsonb),
  'characters',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'char_name',c.char_name,'char_type',c.char_type,'five_layers_json',c.five_layers_json,'arc_json',c.arc_json) ORDER BY c.char_name) FROM public.character c WHERE c.book_id=r.id AND c.is_active AND c.is_formal AND c.is_valid AND NOT c.is_shadow),'[]'::jsonb)
)) END AS response FROM resolved r;

nodes.name: 阶段审计 判断排序是否可进入生产

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload
), normalized AS (
  SELECT
    payload,
    payload->>'stage' AS stage,
    payload->'request' AS request,
    payload->'sort_result' AS sort_result,
    payload->'rpc_request' AS rpc_request,
    CASE WHEN payload #>> '{request,local_operator_id}' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (payload #>> '{request,local_operator_id}')::uuid END AS local_operator_id,
    CASE WHEN payload #>> '{request,book_id}' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (payload #>> '{request,book_id}')::uuid END AS book_id,
    payload #>> '{request,idempotency_key}' AS idempotency_key,
    payload #>> '{request,correlation_id}' AS correlation_id
  FROM input
), tx_state AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(current_setting('v7.zh03_l1a_tx', true), ''), '{}')::jsonb AS value
), sort_serial AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'fp004_02_sort_l1a:' || n.local_operator_id::text || ':' || n.idempotency_key,
    0
  )) AS locked
  FROM normalized AS n
  WHERE n.stage = 'sort_lock'
    AND n.local_operator_id IS NOT NULL
    AND n.book_id IS NOT NULL
    AND public.v7_valid_idempotency_key(n.idempotency_key)
), sort_replay AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT public.v7_replay_product_request(
    'fp004_02_sort_l1a', n.idempotency_key, n.local_operator_id, n.book_id,
    public.v7_request_intent(n.request)
  ) AS response
  FROM normalized AS n
  JOIN sort_serial ON true
  WHERE n.stage = 'sort_lock'
), sort_book_lock AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT book.id, book.local_operator_id
  FROM normalized AS n
  JOIN sort_serial ON true
  LEFT JOIN sort_replay ON true
  JOIN public.book_project AS book
    ON book.id = n.book_id AND book.local_operator_id = n.local_operator_id
  WHERE n.stage = 'sort_lock' AND sort_replay.response IS NULL
  FOR UPDATE OF book
), sort_lock_state AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT set_config('v7.zh03_l1a_tx', (
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(n.payload->'workflow_error') = 'object'
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',n.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object(
          'code',CASE WHEN n.payload #>> '{workflow_error,code}' IN ('CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE','SORT_FAILED','SORT_OUTPUT_INVALID')
            THEN n.payload #>> '{workflow_error,code}' ELSE 'SORT_FAILED' END,
          'message',CASE WHEN n.payload #>> '{workflow_error,code}'='CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE' THEN 'The L1A context could not be loaded.'
            WHEN n.payload #>> '{workflow_error,code}'='SORT_OUTPUT_INVALID' THEN 'The L1A sort output was invalid.'
            ELSE 'The L1A sort model did not complete.' END
        )
      ))
      WHEN n.local_operator_id IS NULL OR n.book_id IS NULL
        OR NOT public.v7_valid_idempotency_key(n.idempotency_key)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',n.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','INVALID_REQUEST','message','The L1A sort request could not be accepted.')
      ))
      WHEN sort_replay.response IS NOT NULL
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',
        sort_replay.response || jsonb_build_object('correlation_id',n.correlation_id))
      WHEN sort_book_lock.id IS NULL
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',n.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','SCOPE_REJECTED','message','The selected book is unavailable.')
      ))
      ELSE jsonb_build_object(
        'mode','sort_locked','book_id',n.book_id,'local_operator_id',n.local_operator_id,
        'idempotency_key',n.idempotency_key
      )
    END
  )::text, true)::jsonb AS value
  FROM normalized AS n
  LEFT JOIN sort_replay ON true
  LEFT JOIN sort_book_lock ON true
  WHERE n.stage = 'sort_lock'
), locked_sort_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT candidate.*
  FROM normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state
  JOIN public.l1a_unit AS candidate
    ON candidate.book_id = n.book_id
   AND NOT candidate.is_formal AND candidate.is_valid AND NOT candidate.is_shadow AND NOT candidate.is_locked
  WHERE n.stage = 'sort_prepare' AND state.value->>'mode' = 'sort_locked'
  ORDER BY candidate.id
  FOR UPDATE OF candidate
), sort_candidate_snapshot AS (
  SELECT
    count(*)::integer AS candidate_count,
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(candidate.id ORDER BY candidate.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS candidate_ids,
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(candidate)-'created_at'-'updated_at' ORDER BY candidate.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS snapshot
  FROM locked_sort_candidates AS candidate
), sort_candidate_fingerprint AS (
  SELECT snapshot.*, encode(digest(convert_to(snapshot.snapshot::text, 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') AS candidate_fingerprint
  FROM sort_candidate_snapshot AS snapshot
), sort_revisions AS (
  SELECT revision.value AS revision, revision.ordinality
  FROM normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(n.sort_result->'candidate_revisions') = 'array'
      THEN n.sort_result->'candidate_revisions' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS revision(value, ordinality)
  WHERE n.stage IN ('sort_prepare','sort_apply','sort_commit')
), sort_order AS (
  SELECT ordered.value AS l1a_id, ordered.ordinality
  FROM normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(n.sort_result->'ordered_l1a_ids') = 'array'
      THEN n.sort_result->'ordered_l1a_ids' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
  ) WITH ORDINALITY AS ordered(value, ordinality)
  WHERE n.stage = 'sort_prepare'
), sort_prepare_check AS (
  SELECT n.*, state.value AS state, snapshot.candidate_count, snapshot.candidate_ids,
    snapshot.candidate_fingerprint,
    public.v7_design_editable(n.book_id) AS design_editable,
    public.v7_formal_design_fingerprint(n.book_id) = COALESCE(n.sort_result->>'design_fingerprint','') AS design_matches,
    snapshot.candidate_fingerprint = COALESCE(n.sort_result->>'candidate_fingerprint','') AS candidate_matches,
    snapshot.candidate_count > 0
    AND jsonb_typeof(n.sort_result->'candidate_revisions') = 'array'
    AND jsonb_array_length(n.sort_result->'candidate_revisions') = snapshot.candidate_count
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM sort_revisions) = snapshot.candidate_count
    AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT revision->>'l1a_id') FROM sort_revisions) = snapshot.candidate_count
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM sort_order) = snapshot.candidate_count
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sort_revisions AS revision
      LEFT JOIN sort_order AS ordered USING (ordinality)
      WHERE revision.revision->>'l1a_id' IS DISTINCT FROM ordered.l1a_id
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM sort_revisions AS item
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(item.revision) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
         OR (SELECT array_agg(key ORDER BY key)
             FROM jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(item.revision)='object' THEN item.revision ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS key)
            IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['arc_requirement','l1a_id','l1a_index','participant_chars_json','plot_emotion_commit']::text[]
         OR COALESCE(item.revision->>'l1a_id','') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
         OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM locked_sort_candidates AS current WHERE current.id::text=lower(item.revision->>'l1a_id'))
         OR COALESCE(item.revision->>'l1a_index','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
         OR (item.revision->>'l1a_index')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM item.ordinality::integer
         OR jsonb_typeof(item.revision->'plot_emotion_commit') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
         OR item.revision->'plot_emotion_commit'='{}'::jsonb
         OR jsonb_typeof(item.revision->'arc_requirement') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
         OR item.revision->'arc_requirement'='{}'::jsonb
         OR jsonb_typeof(item.revision->'participant_chars_json') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
         OR jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(item.revision->'participant_chars_json')='array'
              THEN item.revision->'participant_chars_json' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)=0
         OR (SELECT count(*)<>count(DISTINCT participant.value)
             FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(item.revision->'participant_chars_json')='array'
               THEN item.revision->'participant_chars_json' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS participant(value))
         OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(item.revision->'participant_chars_json')='array'
             THEN item.revision->'participant_chars_json' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS participant(value)
           WHERE participant.value !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
              OR NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM public.character AS character
                WHERE character.id::text=lower(participant.value) AND character.book_id=n.book_id
                  AND character.status='active' AND character.is_active AND character.is_formal
                  AND character.is_valid AND NOT character.is_shadow
              )
         )
    ) AS revision_set_valid
  FROM normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state
  CROSS JOIN sort_candidate_fingerprint AS snapshot
  WHERE n.stage='sort_prepare' AND state.value->>'mode'='sort_locked'
), sort_prepare_state AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT set_config('v7.zh03_l1a_tx', (
    CASE
      WHEN assessment.design_editable IS NOT TRUE
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',assessment.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','L1A_LOCKED','message','The L1A design is already locked.')
      ))
      WHEN assessment.design_matches IS NOT TRUE OR assessment.candidate_matches IS NOT TRUE
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',assessment.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','DESIGN_STATE_CHANGED','message','The L1A candidate snapshot changed while sorting was running.')
      ))
      WHEN assessment.revision_set_valid IS NOT TRUE
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',assessment.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','SORT_WRITE_REJECTED','message','The complete sorted L1A revision set could not be saved.')
      ))
      ELSE jsonb_build_object(
        'mode','sort_valid','book_id',assessment.book_id,'local_operator_id',assessment.local_operator_id,
        'candidate_count',assessment.candidate_count,'candidate_ids',assessment.candidate_ids,
        'pre_candidate_fingerprint',assessment.candidate_fingerprint
      )
    END
  )::text,true)::jsonb AS value
  FROM sort_prepare_check AS assessment
), sort_shifted AS (
  UPDATE api.v_l1a_candidate_write AS candidate
  SET l1a_index=shifted.temporary_index
  FROM (
    SELECT current.id,
      max(current.l1a_index) OVER () + count(*) OVER () + row_number() OVER (ORDER BY current.id) AS temporary_index
    FROM api.v_l1a_candidate_write AS current
    CROSS JOIN normalized AS n
    CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state
    WHERE n.stage='sort_shift' AND state.value->>'mode'='sort_valid'
      AND current.book_id=n.book_id AND current.local_operator_id=n.local_operator_id
      AND current.id::text IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(state.value->'candidate_ids'))
  ) AS shifted
  WHERE candidate.id=shifted.id
  RETURNING candidate.id
), sort_shift_count AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS value FROM sort_shifted
), sort_shift_state AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN count.value=(state.value->>'candidate_count')::integer
      THEN set_config('v7.zh03_l1a_tx',jsonb_set(state.value,'{mode}','"sort_shifted"'::jsonb)::text,true)
    ELSE jsonb_array_length(jsonb_build_object('rollback_required',true))::text
  END AS value
  FROM normalized AS n CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state CROSS JOIN sort_shift_count AS count
  WHERE n.stage='sort_shift' AND state.value->>'mode'='sort_valid'
), sort_applied AS (
  UPDATE api.v_l1a_candidate_write AS candidate
  SET l1a_index=(revision.revision->>'l1a_index')::integer,
      plot_emotion_commit=revision.revision->'plot_emotion_commit',
      arc_requirement=revision.revision->'arc_requirement',
      participant_chars_json=revision.revision->'participant_chars_json',
      status='sorted'
  FROM sort_revisions AS revision
  CROSS JOIN normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state
  WHERE n.stage='sort_apply' AND state.value->>'mode'='sort_shifted'
    AND candidate.book_id=n.book_id AND candidate.local_operator_id=n.local_operator_id
    AND candidate.id::text=lower(revision.revision->>'l1a_id')
  RETURNING candidate.id
), sort_apply_count AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS value FROM sort_applied
), sort_apply_state AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN count.value=(state.value->>'candidate_count')::integer
      THEN set_config('v7.zh03_l1a_tx',jsonb_set(state.value,'{mode}','"sort_applied"'::jsonb)::text,true)
    ELSE jsonb_array_length(jsonb_build_object('rollback_required',true))::text
  END AS value
  FROM normalized AS n CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state CROSS JOIN sort_apply_count AS count
  WHERE n.stage='sort_apply' AND state.value->>'mode'='sort_shifted'
), sort_commit_candidates AS (
  SELECT candidate.*
  FROM public.l1a_unit AS candidate
  CROSS JOIN normalized AS n
  CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state
  WHERE n.stage='sort_commit' AND state.value->>'mode'='sort_applied'
    AND candidate.book_id=n.book_id AND NOT candidate.is_formal
    AND candidate.is_valid AND NOT candidate.is_shadow AND NOT candidate.is_locked
), sort_commit_snapshot AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS candidate_count,
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(candidate)-'created_at'-'updated_at' ORDER BY candidate.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS snapshot
  FROM sort_commit_candidates AS candidate
), sort_commit_check AS (
  SELECT n.*, state.value AS state, snapshot.candidate_count,
    encode(digest(convert_to(snapshot.snapshot::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') AS post_candidate_fingerprint,
    snapshot.candidate_count=(state.value->>'candidate_count')::integer
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sort_revisions AS revision
      LEFT JOIN sort_commit_candidates AS candidate ON candidate.id::text=lower(revision.revision->>'l1a_id')
      WHERE candidate.id IS NULL
         OR candidate.l1a_index IS DISTINCT FROM (revision.revision->>'l1a_index')::integer
         OR candidate.plot_emotion_commit IS DISTINCT FROM revision.revision->'plot_emotion_commit'
         OR candidate.arc_requirement IS DISTINCT FROM revision.revision->'arc_requirement'
         OR candidate.participant_chars_json IS DISTINCT FROM revision.revision->'participant_chars_json'
         OR candidate.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'sorted'
    ) AS valid
  FROM normalized AS n CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state CROSS JOIN sort_commit_snapshot AS snapshot
  WHERE n.stage='sort_commit' AND state.value->>'mode'='sort_applied'
), sort_commit_guard AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT CASE WHEN assessment.valid THEN true
    ELSE jsonb_array_length(jsonb_build_object('rollback_required',true))=0 END AS valid
  FROM sort_commit_check AS assessment
), sort_success AS (
  SELECT assessment.*,
    jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'result',
      (assessment.sort_result-'candidate_fingerprint') || jsonb_build_object('candidate_fingerprint',assessment.post_candidate_fingerprint)
    ) AS stored_result
  FROM sort_commit_check AS assessment CROSS JOIN sort_commit_guard AS guard
  WHERE guard.valid
), sort_logged AS (
  INSERT INTO public.product_request_log(operation,idempotency_key,local_operator_id,book_id,intent,result)
  SELECT 'fp004_02_sort_l1a',success.idempotency_key,success.local_operator_id,success.book_id,
    public.v7_request_intent(success.request),success.stored_result
  FROM sort_success AS success
  RETURNING result
), sort_commit_state AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT set_config('v7.zh03_l1a_tx',jsonb_build_object(
    'mode','terminal','response',logged.result || jsonb_build_object('correlation_id',success.correlation_id)
  )::text,true)::jsonb AS value
  FROM sort_success AS success CROSS JOIN sort_logged AS logged
), finalize_serial AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
    'rpc_finalize_l1a:' || n.local_operator_id::text || ':' || n.idempotency_key,0
  )) AS locked
  FROM normalized AS n
  WHERE n.stage='finalize_lock' AND n.local_operator_id IS NOT NULL AND n.book_id IS NOT NULL
    AND public.v7_valid_idempotency_key(n.idempotency_key)
), finalize_replay AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT public.v7_replay_product_request(
    'rpc_finalize_l1a',n.idempotency_key,n.local_operator_id,n.book_id,
    public.v7_request_intent(n.rpc_request)
  ) AS response
  FROM normalized AS n JOIN finalize_serial ON true
  WHERE n.stage='finalize_lock'
), finalize_book_lock AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT book.id,book.local_operator_id
  FROM normalized AS n JOIN finalize_serial ON true LEFT JOIN finalize_replay ON true
  JOIN public.book_project AS book ON book.id=n.book_id AND book.local_operator_id=n.local_operator_id
  WHERE n.stage='finalize_lock' AND finalize_replay.response IS NULL
  FOR UPDATE OF book
), finalize_lock_state AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT set_config('v7.zh03_l1a_tx',(
    CASE
      WHEN n.local_operator_id IS NULL OR n.book_id IS NULL OR NOT public.v7_valid_idempotency_key(n.idempotency_key)
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',n.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','INVALID_REQUEST','message','The L1A finalization request could not be accepted.')
      ))
      WHEN finalize_replay.response IS NOT NULL
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',
        finalize_replay.response || jsonb_build_object('correlation_id',n.correlation_id))
      WHEN finalize_book_lock.id IS NULL
      THEN jsonb_build_object('mode','terminal','response',jsonb_build_object(
        'ok',false,'correlation_id',n.correlation_id,
        'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','SCOPE_REJECTED','message','The selected book is unavailable.')
      ))
      ELSE jsonb_build_object('mode','finalize_locked','book_id',n.book_id,'local_operator_id',n.local_operator_id)
    END
  )::text,true)::jsonb AS value
  FROM normalized AS n
  LEFT JOIN finalize_replay ON true LEFT JOIN finalize_book_lock ON true
  WHERE n.stage='finalize_lock'
), locked_finalize_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT candidate.*
  FROM normalized AS n CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state
  JOIN public.l1a_unit AS candidate ON candidate.book_id=n.book_id
    AND NOT candidate.is_formal AND candidate.is_valid AND NOT candidate.is_shadow AND NOT candidate.is_locked
  WHERE n.stage='finalize_apply' AND state.value->>'mode'='finalize_locked'
  ORDER BY candidate.id
  FOR UPDATE OF candidate
), finalize_candidate_snapshot AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(candidate)-'created_at'-'updated_at' ORDER BY candidate.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS snapshot
  FROM locked_finalize_candidates AS candidate
), finalize_result AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN state.value->>'mode'='terminal' THEN state.value->'response'
    WHEN encode(digest(convert_to(snapshot.snapshot::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
      IS DISTINCT FROM n.request->>'candidate_fingerprint'
    THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'ok',false,'correlation_id',n.correlation_id,
      'redacted_error',jsonb_build_object('code','DESIGN_STATE_CHANGED','message','The L1A candidate snapshot changed after sorting; sort again before locking.')
    )
    ELSE public.rpc_finalize_l1a(n.rpc_request) || jsonb_build_object('correlation_id',n.correlation_id)
  END AS response
  FROM normalized AS n CROSS JOIN tx_state AS state CROSS JOIN finalize_candidate_snapshot AS snapshot
  WHERE n.stage='finalize_apply'
)
SELECT value->'response' AS response FROM sort_lock_state
UNION ALL SELECT value->'response' FROM sort_prepare_state
UNION ALL SELECT NULL::jsonb FROM sort_shift_state
UNION ALL SELECT NULL::jsonb FROM sort_apply_state
UNION ALL SELECT value->'response' FROM sort_commit_state
UNION ALL SELECT NULL::jsonb FROM finalize_lock_state
UNION ALL SELECT response FROM finalize_result;
